name: Healthcare Claims - Monthly Enrollment Processing
description: Monthly job to process member enrollment, generate member months, and calculate HEDIS quality measures.

tasks.description: Run monthly enrollment stored procedure to generate member month rows
PySpark member month enrollment generation with age bands and demographics
Calculate HEDIS quality measures (BCS, CDC-HBA1C, COL, CBP, PCE)
Refresh mart_claim_summary with latest monthly aggregations

sql_task.query: INSERT OVERWRITE claims_mart.mart_claim_summary SELECT s.patient_id, d.member_key, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.claim_start_date) AS summary_month, YEAR(s.claim_start_date) AS summary_year, MONTH(s.claim_start_date) AS summary_month_number, DATE_FORMAT(s.claim_start_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS summary_year_month, 'MEDICAL' AS claim_category, CASE WHEN s.type_of_bill_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'INPATIENT' WHEN s.place_of_service_code IN ('21', '22', '23') THEN 'OUTPATIENT' WHEN s.place_of_service_code = '20' THEN 'EMERGENCY' ELSE 'PROFESSIONAL' END AS service_category, s.plan_id, s.line_of_business, s.network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.claim_id) AS claim_count, COUNT(*) AS claim_line_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.claim_start_date) AS service_day_count, SUM(COALESCE(s.billed_amount, 0)) AS total_billed_amount, SUM(COALESCE(s.allowed_amount, 0)) AS total_allowed_amount, SUM(COALESCE(s.paid_amount, 0)) AS total_paid_amount, SUM(COALESCE(s.member_liability_amount, 0)) AS total_member_liability, SUM(COALESCE(s.copay_amount, 0)) AS total_copay_amount, SUM(COALESCE(s.coinsurance_amount, 0)) AS total_coinsurance_amount, SUM(COALESCE(s.deductible_amount, 0)) AS total_deductible_amount, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT s.claim_id) > 0 THEN SUM(COALESCE(s.paid_amount, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.claim_id) ELSE 0 END AS avg_paid_per_claim, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT s.claim_start_date) > 0 THEN SUM(COALESCE(s.paid_amount, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.claim_start_date) ELSE 0 END AS avg_paid_per_service_day, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_timestamp FROM claims_staging.stg_medical_claim_current s LEFT JOIN claims_warehouse.dim_member d ON s.patient_id = d.member_id AND d.is_current = TRUE GROUP BY s.patient_id, d.member_key, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.claim_start_date), YEAR(s.claim_start_date), MONTH(s.claim_start_date), DATE_FORMAT(s.claim_start_date, 'yyyy-MM'), CASE WHEN s.type_of_bill_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'INPATIENT' WHEN s.place_of_service_code IN ('21', '22', '23') THEN 'OUTPATIENT' WHEN s.place_of_service_code = '20' THEN 'EMERGENCY' ELSE 'PROFESSIONAL' END, s.plan_id, s.line_of_business, s.network_status;

tasks.description: Refresh mart_encounter_summary with readmission flags and LOS metrics

sql_task.query: INSERT OVERWRITE claims_mart.mart_encounter_summary SELECT e.patient_id, d.member_key, e.encounter_id, e.encounter_type, e.encounter_start_date, e.encounter_end_date, DATE_TRUNC('month', e.encounter_start_date) AS encounter_month, DATE_FORMAT(e.encounter_start_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS encounter_year_month, e.length_of_encounter_days AS length_of_stay_days, e.claim_count, e.principal_diagnosis_code, NULL AS principal_diagnosis_desc, NULL AS diagnosis_category, NULL AS primary_procedure_code, NULL AS drg_code, e.primary_provider_npi, e.facility_npi, e.plan_id, e.line_of_business, e.total_billed_amount, e.total_allowed_amount, e.total_paid_amount, e.total_member_liability, CASE WHEN LAG(e.encounter_end_date) OVER (PARTITION BY e.patient_id ORDER BY e.encounter_start_date) IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(e.encounter_start_date, LAG(e.encounter_end_date) OVER (PARTITION BY e.patient_id ORDER BY e.encounter_start_date)) <= 30 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_readmission_30day, LAG(e.encounter_id) OVER (PARTITION BY e.patient_id ORDER BY e.encounter_start_date) AS prior_encounter_id, DATEDIFF(e.encounter_start_date, LAG(e.encounter_end_date) OVER (PARTITION BY e.patient_id ORDER BY e.encounter_start_date)) AS days_since_prior_discharge, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_timestamp FROM claims_warehouse.fct_encounter e LEFT JOIN claims_warehouse.dim_member d ON e.patient_id = d.member_id AND d.is_current = TRUE;

tasks.description: Optimize mart tables for query performance

sql_task.query: OPTIMIZE claims_mart.mart_member_months ZORDER BY (member_id, enrollment_month); OPTIMIZE claims_mart.mart_claim_summary ZORDER BY (patient_id, summary_month); OPTIMIZE claims_mart.mart_encounter_summary ZORDER BY (patient_id, encounter_start_date); OPTIMIZE claims_mart.mart_quality_measures ZORDER BY (patient_id, measure_id); ANALYZE TABLE claims_mart.mart_member_months COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR ALL COLUMNS; ANALYZE TABLE claims_mart.mart_claim_summary COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR ALL COLUMNS;
